title: Hochschild Cohomology of the Symmetric Square of an Annulus with Stops
summary: We compute the Hochschild cohomology of the partially wrapped Fukaya category of the symmetric square of an annulus with stops. Using an explicit generating set in this category, we give a description of its dg endomorphism algebra $\widetilde{\mathcal{A}}_{n_1,n_2}$ via a quiver with relations. We show that when one boundary component has a single stop, the dg algebra is formal; however, when both boundaries contain at least two stops, it is not formal, and its minimal $A_\infty$-model carries a nontrivial operation $m_3$. This allows us to compute its Hochschild cohomology via reduction…
